title: Holographic Thoughts
description: Self-contained interactive web page with five toy views of holographic-membrane models (projection recall, coupled loop, Hebbian crystallization, calibrated refusal gate, outer-product capacity). Synthetic toy, classical simulation; not physical holography or quantum hardware.
notes: Synthetic toy, classical simulation. Browser views are illustrative; measured numbers come from the linked Python models. Concept DOI (all versions) 10.5281/zenodo.23619508; version DOI for v0.1.0 10.5281/zenodo.23619509.
